reason: The Open-IDE producer stop ("the entry of branch main-weft is ended on origin, so the branch was not pushed") cannot be named from what I read. The commit it names, b113997e08 ("batten: Open-IDE -> running"), is an ancestor of origin/main-weft (181a2955, equal to local HEAD, nothing unpushed), so the branch is not absent and the commit is present. The message comes from the fallback in recordsSideNotLanded (internal/fabricengine/pushanchored.go:297-309), which fires when a push returns nil without a deferred record, and I did not establish why it fired on an already-landed commit or whether the run's board entry is actually ended. A plain re-launch would most likely hit the same fallback, so resume does not settle it, and the cause needs code judged. See case-brief.md.
